svg.title: sd UC4 paid join confirmed by webhook (design model)
svg.desc: UML design sequence diagram: Stripe webhook verified outside the transaction, then one transaction claims the event, locks the team row FOR UPDATE, locks the payment, fulfils through OrderFulfilmentAdapter and PaidGroupDealService (receipt lock, clock after lock, GroupDeal.joinPaid, guarded UPDATE); alt admitted (MemberJoined, TeamSucceeded when last seat, BEFORE_COMMIT order confirmation) or rejected (receipt compensation_required, refund obligation).
svg.text: sd UC4 paid join confirmed by webhook (design model)
[tx.executeWithoutResult: one DB transaction, READ_COMMITTED, timeout 10 s]
[joinPaid returned: seat available, window open, new member]
[joinPaid threw: team full or closed, already a member, amount mismatch]
